answer: Rotating Sparrow Quota. Each epoch, a verifiable random function (seeded by a comet-anchored beacon) shuffles enrolled agents into eligibility cohorts; only cohort members may submit work, and cohort size is capped. Attackers cannot precompute placement, so mass-registered identities idle most epochs while paying full maintenance. A fable clause: identities unused for two consecutive epochs lapse and must requeue with fresh randomness, adding delay cost per sybil.
